item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-29
item.description:
It's been an exciting week in our open-source research community, with notable updates to both the `scienceverse/metacheck` and `marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing` projects. The `metacheck` team made progress on the `data_check` branch, adding statistical output related to Lakens, which will enhance the tool's data analysis capabilities. Meanwhile, the `tenzing` project saw updates to both its `gh-pages` and `master` branches, including a site build for version `0.4.1` and a refinement to the success alert title in `sweet_alert.js`. These developments demonstrate the connections between our projects, as improved data analysis in `metacheck` can inform and enhance the work being done in `tenzing`. Overall, it's great to see our community members driving progress and collaborating across projects to advance open-source research.

5 commits across 2 active repositories this week.
